overview:
**High fire danger continues today, driven by elevated energy release component (ERC 88%) despite a chance of afternoon storms.**
- Danger climbs to Very High by midweek (Aug 26-28) as humidity drops to 15% and winds build to 13 mph.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions took effect Aug. 21 in the Uncompahgre and Gunnison BLM field offices, while unincorporated Montrose County remains under county-imposed Stage 2 restrictions.
- Today's watchout status: 0 of 7 local fire-behavior thresholds met; no Red Flag Warning is posted, though scattered thunderstorms (60% chance) could bring gusty, erratic winds this afternoon.
- The Gold Mountain Fire near Ouray sits at 39,691 acres| Containment: 87%, with area, road, and trail closures still in effect.
- The Elk Fire on the Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison National Forest is holding at 7,257 acres and 33% contained.
- Expect building smoke-cure conditions and drying fuels through the week; keep an eye on wind shifts near active fire perimeters.
